sources.provider: Purdue Archives and Special Collections, Armory corporate entity record
sources.source_date: Record describes 1918-present facility and 1928 fire event
sources.supports: The current Armory was built in 1918 after a 1916 fire at the earlier armory; its program included ROTC, classrooms, offices, a large drill deck, and rifle range. The record describes a 1928 fire in which roofing tiles fell from the roof.
sources.uncertainty: The archive text does not provide total height, exact story count, measured roof geometry, or confirmation of current roof surfacing.

sources.uncertainty: Confirms a second floor is accessed, not the building's total number of floors or basement condition.

model_changes.footprint: Structural perimeter wall meshes were adjusted in XY to match the four GIS ring bounds relative to the unchanged manifest placement origin. Pre-fit perimeter: X [-35.5250, 15.9750] m; Y [-44.6500, 44.6500] m. Post-fit perimeter matches the GIS target within 0.001 m.
model_changes.roof: Removed the unsupported four tall corner tower forms, raised battlements/merlons, ridge monitor, former hipped roof patch and unverified exposed trusses. Added a simple longitudinal gabled roof and the photo-supported central stepped cross-gable with arched upper fanlight. Main roof form, gable width and all elevations are estimates.
model_changes.windows: Corrected the prior 216 repair-frame/muntin objects that were offset from the wall planes; they now sit just outside the GIS-matched east/west structural walls.
model_changes.export: Preview lights were moved to scene-only collection Armory_Preview_Setup. No cameras or lights are inside Asset_armory. Existing packed image materials are retained; the linked foliage library remains a relative project path.
model_changes.saved_file_version: The existing file was written by Blender 5.02.45; it was opened/saved with Blender 4.5.15, which warned once about newer-file compatibility. The saved result reopened successfully with the expected scene, collection, geometry, and materials. A validation render was produced from the reopened saved asset.

verification.reopened_export_probe: audit/armory/armory_asset_collection_probe.blend; reopened with Asset_armory and central gable, 703 objects, no camera/light objects

height_and_story_status.modeled_height_status: All model elevations are visual/typology estimates; not a survey or GIS height measurement.
height_and_story_status.story_evidence: The archival exterior shows two principal windowed levels and an attic/gable light; the current AFROTC page mentions access to a second floor. Total story count, attic use, and basement status remain unverified.
height_and_story_status.roof_material: Archival account documents roof tiles during the 1928 fire; current roof finish is unknown. The muted tile-toned model material is illustrative only.
